To insert the mirror, first remove the mirror ring by unscrewing it with the Needle Nose Pliers. The ring has two indents for this purpose.

There are different types and sizes of mirrors. If the mirror has one opaque side and one mirrored side, the mirrored side is used to redirect the laser beam. If the mirror has two mirrored sides. Use the yellow side to redirect the laser beam.

The mirrored surface has to stay clean in order to reflect the laser beam properly. For this reason, it is very important to not touch it. The mirror has to be held carefully on the sides. Any dirt, scratch marks or grease will influence negatively the results of the cut and engraving.
Remember to hold the mirror on the sides. DO NOT TOUCH THE MIRRORED SURFACE. Insert the mirror in the correct position as illustrated.
Once the mirror is in, put the ring back and tighten it loosely with the Needle Nose Pliers. If you tighten too hard it might crack the mirror.

For the machine to cut and engrave well, it is important that the laser beam is directed correctly to the Laser Lens. The mirrors are responsible to redirect the beam. For that, they need to be positioned in the correct angle.

Each Mirror Holder contains 3 knobs. By rotating each knob, the angle of the mirror can be calibrated in different directions as shown in the image. Also, the entire Mirror Holder can be moved back and forth if necessary.
The knobs push the corners of the holder, tilting the mirror. To facilitate the calibration, reset the holder by unscrewing the knobs until they are not touching the holder.
How to move the Laser Tube for Calibration
The Laser Tube can be moved to have an extra possibility to calibrate the laser beam.
Make sure the Laser Tube is properly fixed by tightening the laser Tube Holders but the Laser Tube Holders can slide stiff over the horizontal Laser Panel
Make sure the Laser Tube is parallel to the Middle Panel.
How to fixate the calibrated mirrors
After the calibration, tighten the Fix Nuts very carefully to lock the calibration screws. Fixate them with a hot-glue gun.
To insert the lens, first remove the ring by unscrewing it with the Needle Nose Pliers. The ring has two indents for this purpose.
The laserhead has to be seperate to be able to show the interior with ring. Exagerate the flat & convex side of the lens object for better understanding
Insert the lens with two rubber rings from both sides. Make sure the flat side of the lens is facing down
Once the lens is in, put the ring back and tighten it loosely with the Needle Nose Pliers.
